cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# screen_capture_lib â€?cross-platform build
#
#   Windows : GDI / DXGI / WGC paths
#   Linux   : X11 paths (WEBRTC_USE_X11) + optional PipeWire/Wayland portal
#   macOS   : CoreGraphics / IOSurface paths (Objective-C++)
#
# Source groups come from vendored/manifest.cmake (generated by
# tools/vendor_from_webrtc.py, one group per platform).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
project(screen_capture
        VERSION 1.0.0
        DESCRIPTION "Screen/window capture library extracted from WebRTC desktop_capture"
        LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(SCL_VENDOR_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vendored" CACHE PATH
    "Directory holding the vendored WebRTC/libyuv/abseil sources")
option(SCL_BUILD_SHARED   "Build screen_capture as a shared library" OFF)
option(SCL_BUILD_DEMO     "Build the demo executable" ON)
option(SCL_STATIC_RUNTIME "MSVC: link the static runtime (/MT instead of /MD)" OFF)
option(SCL_USE_PIPEWIRE   "Linux: enable the PipeWire/Wayland (portal) capture path" OFF)
option(SCL_ENABLE_WGC     "Windows: enable the Windows Graphics Capture path
(requires C++/WinRT headers; MSVC or MSYS2 mingw-w64 with winrt)")

set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ${SCL_BUILD_SHARED})

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)

include("${SCL_VENDOR_DIR}/manifest.cmake")

if(NOT (WIN32 OR APPLE OR UNIX))
  message(FATAL_ERROR "screen_capture_lib supports Windows, Linux and macOS only")
endif()
if(APPLE)
  enable_language(OBJCXX)
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Platform
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if(WIN32)
  set(SCL_OS "win")
elseif(APPLE)
  set(SCL_OS "mac")
else()
  set(SCL_OS "linux")
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sources
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(SCL_LIB_SOURCES
  src/screen_capture.cc
  src/capture.cc
  src/capture_internal.cc
  ${SCL_DC_COMMON_SOURCES}
  ${SCL_RUNTIME_SOURCES}
  ${SCL_ABSL_SOURCES}
  ${SCL_LIBYUV_GENERIC_SOURCES})

# libyuv ISA variants: row.h enables SSSE3 paths for MSVC x64 whose
# implementations live in *_win.cc; GCC/Clang builds use the *_gcc.cc set.
if(MSVC)
  list(APPEND SCL_LIB_SOURCES ${SCL_LIBYUV_MSVC_SOURCES})
else()
  list(APPEND SCL_LIB_SOURCES ${SCL_LIBYUV_GNU_SOURCES})
endif()

if(SCL_OS STREQUAL "win")
  list(APPEND SCL_LIB_SOURCES ${SCL_DC_WIN_SOURCES})
  if(NOT SCL_ENABLE_WGC)
    # WGC needs C++/WinRT headers (<winrt/...>, <DispatcherQueue.h>) which
    # stock MinGW-w64 does not ship; exclude the WGC TUs plus the Direct3D
    # interop helper only they use, and turn the feature off. The DXGI and
    # GDI paths are unaffected.
    foreach(_src ${SCL_DC_WIN_SOURCES})
      if(_src MATCHES "/wgc_")
        list(REMOVE_ITEM SCL_LIB_SOURCES ${_src})
      endif()
    endforeach()
    list(REMOVE_ITEM SCL_LIB_SOURCES
      "${SCL_VENDOR_DIR}/rtc_base/win/create_direct3d_device.cc")
  endif()
elseif(SCL_OS STREQUAL "linux")
  list(APPEND SCL_LIB_SOURCES ${SCL_DC_X11_SOURCES})
  if(SCL_USE_PIPEWIRE)
    list(APPEND SCL_LIB_SOURCES ${SCL_DC_PIPEWIRE_SOURCES})
  endif()
else()
  list(APPEND SCL_LIB_SOURCES
    ${SCL_DC_MAC_CC_SOURCES}
    ${SCL_DC_MAC_OBJC_SOURCES}
    ${SCL_SDK_OBJC_SOURCES})
endif()

add_library(screen_capture ${SCL_LIB_SOURCES})

target_compile_features(screen_capture PUBLIC cxx_std_17)

target_include_directories(screen_capture
  PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
    $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
  PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
    ${SCL_VENDOR_DIR}
    ${SCL_VENDOR_DIR}/third_party/abseil-cpp
    ${SCL_VENDOR_DIR}/third_party/libyuv/include)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Defines
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(SCL_PRIVATE_DEFINES
  WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
  NOMINMAX
  __STDC_FORMAT_MACROS
  DYNAMIC_ANNOTATIONS_ENABLED=0
  ABSL_ALLOCATOR_NOTHROW=1
  LIBYUV_DISABLE_NEON
  LIBYUV_DISABLE_LSX
  LIBYUV_DISABLE_LASX
  NVALGRIND)

if(MINGW)
  target_compile_options(screen_capture PRIVATE -fno-tree-vectorize -fno-tree-slp-vectorize)
  # The vendored libyuv enables its GNU AVX2 asm purely by GCC version
  # (GCC_HAS_AVX2); on MinGW-w64 7.3 those hand-written routines crash at
  # runtime. Scalar paths cost a few ms per 1080p frame â€?negligible next to
  # encoding â€?so disable x86 SIMD entirely on MinGW.
  list(APPEND SCL_PRIVATE_DEFINES LIBYUV_DISABLE_X86)
endif()

if(SCL_OS STREQUAL "win")
  list(APPEND SCL_PRIVATE_DEFINES
    WEBRTC_WIN WIN32 _UNICODE UNICODE
    _WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00 NTDDI_VERSION=NTDDI_WIN10_NI PSAPI_VERSION=2
    WINAPI_FAMILY=WINAPI_FAMILY_DESKTOP_APP
    _CRT_SECURE_NO_DEPRECATE _SCL_SECURE_NO_DEPRECATE
    _CRT_NONSTDC_NO_WARNINGS __STD_C _CRT_RAND_S
    WEBRTC_NON_STATIC_TRACE_EVENT_HANDLERS=0)
  if(SCL_ENABLE_WGC)
    list(APPEND SCL_PRIVATE_DEFINES RTC_ENABLE_WIN_WGC)
  endif()
elseif(SCL_OS STREQUAL "linux")
  list(APPEND SCL_PRIVATE_DEFINES WEBRTC_POSIX WEBRTC_LINUX WEBRTC_USE_X11)
  if(SCL_USE_PIPEWIRE)
    # Direct libpipewire link: no dlopen stubs, so no generated
    # pipewire_stubs.h is needed.
    list(APPEND SCL_PRIVATE_DEFINES RTC_LINK_PIPEWIRE)
  endif()
else()
  list(APPEND SCL_PRIVATE_DEFINES WEBRTC_POSIX WEBRTC_MAC)
endif()

target_compile_definitions(screen_capture PRIVATE ${SCL_PRIVATE_DEFINES})
target_compile_definitions(screen_capture PRIVATE
  $<$<BOOL:${SCL_BUILD_SHARED}>:SCL_BUILDING_DLL>)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Link libraries
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if(SCL_OS STREQUAL "win")
  target_link_libraries(screen_capture PRIVATE
    user32 gdi32 ole32 advapi32 winmm ws2_32
    d3d11 dxgi dwmapi)
  if(MSVC)
    # MinGW builds resolve shcore.dll at runtime (see comdef/DPI shims);
    # MSVC links it directly.
    target_link_libraries(screen_capture PRIVATE shcore)
  endif()
elseif(SCL_OS STREQUAL "linux")
  find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
  pkg_check_modules(SCL_X11 REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET
    x11 xcomposite xdamage xext xfixes xrender xrandr xtst)
  target_link_libraries(screen_capture PRIVATE PkgConfig::SCL_X11)
  if(SCL_USE_PIPEWIRE)
    # Mirrors modules/portal/BUILD.gn "pipewire_all".
    pkg_check_modules(SCL_PIPEWIRE REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET
      libpipewire-0.3 gbm egl epoxy libdrm gio-2.0 gio-unix-2.0)
    target_link_libraries(screen_capture PRIVATE PkgConfig::SCL_PIPEWIRE)
  endif()
  find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
  target_link_libraries(screen_capture PRIVATE Threads::Threads ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
else()
  target_link_libraries(screen_capture PRIVATE
    "-framework AppKit"
    "-framework IOKit"
    "-framework IOSurface"
    "-framework AVFoundation"
    "-framework CoreMedia"
    "-framework Foundation")
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compile flags
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(screen_capture PRIVATE /W3 /MP /bigobj
    /permissive- /Zc:__cplusplus /utf-8)
  if(SCL_STATIC_RUNTIME)
    set_target_properties(screen_capture PROPERTIES
      MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
  endif()
else()
  # BUILD.gn gives differ_vector_sse2.cc an explicit -msse2 on POSIX.
  set_source_files_properties(
    "${SCL_VENDOR_DIR}/modules/desktop_capture/differ_vector_sse2.cc"
    PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-msse2")
  # The macOS .mm files are built with ARC (mirrors the WebRTC build).
  set_source_files_properties(
    ${SCL_DC_MAC_OBJC_SOURCES} ${SCL_SDK_OBJC_SOURCES}
    PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-fobjc-arc")
endif()

if(SCL_BUILD_SHARED)
  set_target_properties(screen_capture PROPERTIES
    POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON
    OUTPUT_NAME screen_capture)
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Demo
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if(SCL_BUILD_DEMO)
  add_executable(scl_demo examples/scl_demo.cc)
  target_link_libraries(scl_demo PRIVATE screen_capture)
  target_compile_definitions(scl_demo PRIVATE
    $<$<BOOL:${SCL_BUILD_SHARED}>:SCL_DLL>)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(scl_demo PRIVATE /W4 /utf-8)
    if(SCL_STATIC_RUNTIME)
      set_target_properties(scl_demo PROPERTIES
        MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
    endif()
  endif()
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Install
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
include(GNUInstallDirs)
install(TARGETS screen_capture
        RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}
        LIBRARY DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
        ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR})
install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})
install(FILES "${SCL_VENDOR_DIR}/LICENSE.webrtc"
        DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATAROOTDIR}/licenses/screen_capture
        RENAME LICENSE.webrtc)
install(FILES "${SCL_VENDOR_DIR}/third_party/libyuv/LICENSE"
        DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATAROOTDIR}/licenses/screen_capture
        RENAME LICENSE.libyuv)
install(FILES "${SCL_VENDOR_DIR}/third_party/abseil-cpp/LICENSE"
        DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATAROOTDIR}/licenses/screen_capture
        RENAME LICENSE.abseil)
